server.name: io.form/formio-mcp
server.description: Create and manage Form.io forms, resources, actions, roles, and projects from your AI agent.

environmentVariables.description: Optional, and the WEAKEST of the three project sources: a committed formio.json found by walking up from the working directory wins, then the per-directory mapping project_set writes, then this. It pins nothing — project_set can redirect a directory whose environment names a different project. Useful for a launch with nowhere to record a project, such as CI or a container (e.g. https://examples.form.io on the hosted cloud; self-hosted it is either https://your-project.your-domain.com or https://your-host/project-name, depending on how that deployment routes projects). Leave it unset and the agent asks for a project and records it per directory.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_PROJECT_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional, and usually unnecessary: the base URL is DERIVED from the project URL — https://api.form.io for a project on a form.io host, the parent path for a project addressed as a sub-directory — and is asked for only when it cannot be derived, which is a path-less project URL on a customer domain. There is no default. Like FORMIO_PROJECT_URL it is the weakest source, behind a committed formio.json and the per-directory mapping.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Form.io project API key. Optional — applied only to the project FORMIO_PROJECT_URL names, so set FORMIO_PROJECT_URL beside it; any other project, and every project when it is omitted, uses the browser-based portal login flow to obtain a JWT.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: URL of a custom login form used by the browser-based portal login flow. Defaults to the deployment's portal login form.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_LOGIN_FORM

environmentVariables.description: Address the browser-login page binds to. Optional; defaults to 127.0.0.1. Set it to 0.0.0.0, together with FORMIO_AUTH_PORT, when the server runs in a container or on a remote machine and the login page must be reachable through a published port. 0.0.0.0 exposes the page on every interface for the duration of a login.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_AUTH_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Fixed port for the browser-login page, so a container can publish it (e.g. 43117). Optional; a positive integer, and by default the page takes an ephemeral port.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_AUTH_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for a browser login before the call fails with an error naming the remedies. Optional; a positive integer no larger than 2147483, and any other value is ignored. Defaults to 900.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_AUTH_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to attempt the browser login even where the server detects it cannot present one (CI, a container, a remote shell with no display). Use it when the login page is reachable from a browser elsewhere.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_FORCE_BROWSER

environmentVariables.description: Seconds a Form.io request may go unanswered before the call fails with a network error naming the URL. Optional; a positive integer no larger than 2147483, and any other value is ignored. Defaults to 60. project_import and project_export wait 300 seconds, or this value when it is longer.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_REQUEST_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification only for requests to the configured deployment (the hosts of the resolved project URL and base URL); every other host is verified as usual. For local development against self-signed certificates only — never enable in production.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_INSECURE_TLS

environmentVariables.description: Ethereum private key for write/buy tools (subscribe, unsubscribe, publish, buy_data). buy_data spends real Base-mainnet USDC — use a dedicated wallet. Not required for read-only tools.
environmentVariables.name: PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: RPC for the on-chain library + EIP-712 attestation layer (Arbitrum Sepolia, eip155:421614). The x402 buy rail settles USDC on Base mainnet and needs no RPC here. Defaults to Arbitrum Sepolia public RPC.
environmentVariables.name: RPC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Gateway attester address byte_buy_data pins receipts against. Defaults to the current PayPerByte gateway attester (rotated 2026-08-19; previous default 0x77c86a...C472 is retired). Override only if the gateway discloses a rotation you need ahead of a package update - see /.well-known/agent.json receipt.attester and receipt.retiredAttesters.
environmentVariables.name: BYTE_GATEWAY_ATTESTER

environmentVariables.description: "false" makes write tools broadcast by default (they still need confirm: true). Default true: simulate only.
environmentVariables.name: HEDGEHOOD_DRY_RUN

environmentVariables.description: Cap per x402 deposit, USDG
environmentVariables.name: HEDGEHOOD_MAX_DEPOSIT
